other_failure_modes.name: Discarded test IDs
other_failure_modes.description: The agent discards the original identifier column from the test set and hardcodes an index sequence (e.g. np.arange) for the submission file. This will cause submission scoring to fail if the test set IDs are not a simple zero-indexed sequence.

summary: The agent provides a structurally sound LightGBM pipeline with proper K-Fold cross validation and independent train/test processing. However, it lacks any feature engineering (FM07) and relies on a single metric for evaluation (FM15). Critically, it discards the original test IDs and generates a new sequential ID for the submission, which will likely invalidate the submission file format.
